stem.text: The diagram represents a sphere under water. P, Q, R and S are forces acting on the sphere due to the pressure of the water.

stem.alt: Circle inside a grey rectangle of water, with a horizontal line labelled water surface along the top; arrows labelled P (downwards), Q (leftwards), R (upwards) and S (rightwards) act on the circle.

stem.text: Each force acts perpendicularly to the sphere's surface. P and R act in opposite directions vertically. Q and S act in opposite directions horizontally.
Which information about the magnitudes of the forces is correct?
